description: This file implements the Watchlist page component for a stock market web app, providing CRUD operations with localStorage persistence. It includes features like adding, editing, deleting, sorting watchlist items, and accessibility considerations.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a re-render by updating the internal state version.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new stock symbol to the watchlist after validation.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing mode for a specific watchlist item.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels the editing mode and resets edit states.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves the edits made to a watchlist item, updating the store.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms and processes deletion of a watchlist item.
